name: Marble Dash
hook: Roll your marble to the goal. Don't fall off.
how: Everyone rolls a marble down the same sky course at once: steep ramps, jumps over gaps, bumpers, moving platforms and a spinning sweeper. Fall off and you go back to the last checkpoint. First to the goal wins.
controls: WASD or arrows to roll, Space to jump, or a stick and a Jump button
uses: The fastest runs to the goal.
The host's browser starts each round and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots roll with you, and sometimes fall off, until enough people join.
Every marble rolls for everyone at once, and the moving platforms run on one shared clock.
ideas: Add a loop the marbles roll around
Add ice that makes marbles slide
Give the winner a golden marble next round
